entities.name: Khalifa bin Zayed Al Nahyan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leader of United Arab Emirates (2004–2022). Al Nahyan; Abu Dhabi ruler; stroke 2014 (incapacitated, brother MBZ de facto ruler); rarely seen publicly; died 2022; Burj Khalifa named after him (bailout)
